source_title: Nokia 2360 Flip Phone Launches With Dual Display, SOS Button - TelecomTalk
source_excerpt:
HMD Global brings back the nostalgic Nokia flip-phone experience with a dual-display design and three colour options.
HMD Global also adds Family Assist to the Nokia 2360 Flip Phone, letting relatives remotely add contacts, adjust volume, and set reminders on the device.
The Nokia 2360 Flip includes practical features such as expandable storage up to 32GB, USB Type-C and a 3.5mm headphone jack.

HMD Global launches the all-new Nokia 2360 Flip Phone, bringing 90s and early 2000s nostalgia with a modern dual display. It features a flip design with an inner display and a secondary outer display. It also has a dedicated SOS button and a “Family Assist Feature” that lets family members remotely manage the device, making it a great phone for Indian citizens. It also supports 2G connectivity out of the box. The new Nokia 2360 Flip is available in Charcoal, Teal, and Burgundy Red, though the India price is not yet confirmed. If you are looking for a new flip phone for your parents, we’ve got you covered with the features and expected pricing for the Nokia 2360 Flip.
The Nokia 2360 Flip features a 2.8-inch main display and a 1.77-inch external screen in a classic flip-phone design.
HMD Global’s new Nokia 2360 Flip Phone also gets a dedicated SOS button, and the Family Assist feature provides emergency alerts and remote device management for family members.
On the battery front, the Nokia 2360 Flip Phone comes with a removable 1,450mAh battery

HMD Global Nokia 2360 Flip Phone Launched – Specifications and Features
HMD Global is a global smartphone company that owns and operates Nokia. Under the Nokia brand, which has operated in India for decades, Nokia brings back a nostalgic flip phone with a modern touch, making it a great modern flip phone while still offering accessibility for senior citizens.
The Nokia 2360 Fkip phone features a 2.8-inch primary display with 320×240 pixels (QVGA), while the outer display is a 1.77-inch QVGA panel with 160×128 pixels.

Nokia has not confirmed the processor powering the 2360 Flip Phone , but the new dual-screen flip phones pack 4MB of RAM and 4MB of internal storage, expandable to 32GB with a microSD card.

The camera features a single lens on the outer display. Although HMD or Nokia has not confirmed the exact megapixel count, you should take photos using the outer display.
The Nokia 2360 Flip Phone comes with 2G connectivity out of the box; HMD should consider at least 3G or 4G connectivity, as Indian telecom operators are moving to decommission 2G in India.
Nokia’s new 2360 Flip packs a larger 1450mAh removable battery and adds a loudspeaker.
On the software front, the new Nokia 2360 Flip runs on Nokia Series 30+ OS, which brings new features.
Nokia 2360 Flip Phone adds more features, including Family Assist, which lets family members remotely manage the device, add contacts, adjust volume levels, and set reminders.
It also has a dedicated SOS button on the rear; when you press it, the pre-set emergency contact receives an alert message. Other features include FM Radio and a 3.5mm headphone jack. You also get a USB Type-C port.

HMD Global Nokia 2360 Flip Phone: India Price
HMD Global has not yet disclosed the India price of the Nokia 2360 Flip phone. We will have to wait for Nokia or HMD to confirm the price and whether it will launch in India.

The Nokia 2360 Flip is a dual-screen feature phone launched by HMD Global under the Nokia brand. It combines a classic flip design with modern features like a dedicated SOS button and Family Assist.
What is the display size of the Nokia 2360 Flip?
The Nokia 2360 Flip features a 2.8-inch QVGA primary display and a 1.77-inch secondary outer display.
Does the Nokia 2360 Flip support 4G connectivity?
No, the HMD Nokia 2360 Flip phone doesn’t support 4G connectivity. It currently supports 2G connectivity, though it’s a legacy system since telecom operators plan to decommission 2G network towers.
Does the Nokia 2360 Flip have an SOS button?
Yes, the Nokia 2360 Flip phone features a dedicated SOS button on the rear. Pressing it sends an alert message to a preset emergency contact.
What is the India price of the Nokia 2360 Flip?
HMD Global has not yet announced the India price for the Nokia 2360. Its availability and launch timeline for the Indian market are also unconfirmed.
